lines.text: Between two repaints, the Eiffel Tower loses about fifteen tonnes of paint.
It has been repainted twenty times in one hundred thirty-six years.
That's an average of once every seven years.
Each repaint takes sixty tonnes of paint, and about fifteen tonnes wears away between coats.
Skip a few of those sevens, with no one there to paint, and the paint is gone from the metal beneath.
Bare steel is the next problem, and it's inside so many of our buildings.
So what happens when the steel is bare? The full video on our channel has the answer. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
